text:
Meet Hop to Olympus ☁️ A voxel action RPG that runs right in your browser. No download. No sign-up. Desktop, tablet or phone: keyboard, touch or gamepad. ⚔️ Climb six worlds: from the Cloud Isles to the Gates of Olympus, space and neon Horai. 19 regions, 33 bosses with their own phases, arenas and legendary loot. 🦘 Movement is the weapon: hop on the beat (the 5th jump is a mega jump), dash, wall-run, grapple and fly. 🔨 12 weapon types, 32 craftable items and 8 relics. Skill beats stats. ☁️ Hatch a Kumo: a cloud buddy that grows into one of six adult forms. Ultra-rare: 1%, odds are public. 👥 Up to 32 players in one room, your own island, time trials against your ghost and a map editor.
Built from scratch by a small studio. The whole game is just 1.47 MB.
🧪 Alpha test: opening soon. 💬 Join our Discord to share ideas and bugs, we read everything. 👇 Follow the channel to hear first. #HopToOlympus

Six worlds. One climb. 🌍 From the Cloud Isles to neon Horai, every world changes the rules, the enemies and the music.
19 regions · 33 bosses · legendary loot
☁️ Blooming Isles · ⚡ Gates of Olympus · 🌌 Space · 🔥 Forge of Hephaestus · ⭐ Star Dome · 🏮 Neon Quarter Which world do you want to see first? 👇 #HopToOlympus

Meet Kumo ☁️💗 A cloud buddy that hatches from an egg, grows, evolves and joins your adventures. 🥚 Egg → 🐣 baby → 🌱 teen → ✨ one of six adult forms
Ultra-rare form: 1% chance, and the odds are public.
What would you name yours? 👇 #HopToOlympus #Kumo

Not a single clone. 👹 Gryphons, titans, gorgons, nightmares and neon dragons: 33 bosses with their own phases, arenas and legendary loot.
No copy-paste fights. Every boss asks for a different plan.
Which one would you fight first? 👇 #HopToOlympus #BossFight

Movement is the weapon. 🦘 Hop on the beat: every jump in a streak is faster, and the fifth one is a mega jump. ➕ dash · wall-runs · grappling hook · wings
Skill beats stats here.
#HopToOlympus #indiegame
Best friends ☁️💗 Pick a hero, hatch a Kumo and bring a friend along. 👥 Up to 32 players in one room 🌐 No download. No sign-up. 🧪 Alpha test: opening soon. Who are you bringing? 👇 #HopToOlympus

Loot it. Craft it. Equip it. 🔨 Mobs drop materials, and you forge armour, wings and legendary weapons.
32 items · 8 relics · 12 weapon types
⭐ The Starbreaker can only be forged in the Star Dome. What would you craft first? 👇 #HopToOlympus #crafting

Upgrade your gear ⬆️ 🐢 Turtle Armor: 3 armor hearts 🥷 Shadow Garb: 5 armor hearts, +10% run speed 🟣 Erebus Armor: 7 armor hearts, +15% run speed Loot it. Craft it. Wear it. Which look is yours? 👇 #HopToOlympus

Up to 32 players in one room. 👥
Shared bosses, shared loot and XP.
Honest co-op: the fight leader stays put, boss health is shared and hits are never dropped. Who are you bringing? 👇 #HopToOlympus #coop

33 bosses. All wanted. 🤠 Zeus, Medusa, Kronos and 30 more are waiting on the way up, each with its own arena and legendary loot. 🗡 Hunt them solo or with up to 32 players. Which boss is your first target? 👇 #HopToOlympus

From egg to legend. 🥚➡️✨ Feed it, care for it and watch your Kumo change: baby, teen, then one of six adult forms.
And once in a hundred hatches, an ultra-rare.
Which form do you want? 👇 #HopToOlympus #Kumo

Your boarding pass to Olympus ✈️☁️ 🎫 Class: co-op, up to 32 🌐 No download. No sign-up. Any screen.
Gate: alpha test, opening soon.
Follow to hear first. #HopToOlympus
Swing. Dash. Repeat. ⚔️ 12 weapon types, plus hops, dashes and a mega jump on every fifth hop. Pick your style. Which weapon are you? 👇 #HopToOlympus #actionRPG
Would you rather... 🤔 🔱 Spear or ⚔️ twin blades? 12 weapon types are waiting in the alpha, each with its own fighting style. Comment your side 👇 #HopToOlympus

99% vs 1%. 🎲 Every Kumo hatch has a 1% chance to be ultra-rare. The odds are public, and every ultra-rare gets its own unique number.
No fog, no tricks.
#HopToOlympus #indiegame
Neon Horai 🏮 The last world glows. ☁️ Cloud Harbor 🌃 Neon Quarter 🏯 Jade Palace Which world do you want to see first? 👇 #HopToOlympus
Pick your hero. 🃏 Ginger, Rina or Sergio: three heroes, 12 weapon types and the same mega jump on every fifth hop. Who are you playing? 👇 #HopToOlympus
Race your ghost. 👻 Five time trial tracks, a ghost of your best run and shared leaderboards. Hops and dashes decide everything. Can you beat yourself? 👇 #HopToOlympus #timetrial

Where we are 🗺️ ✅ Shipped: Cloud Isles, Chaos Rift, Star Dome, Horai, your island, Kumo 🛠 In progress: a shared home for two, the alpha test, deeper RPG lore ⏭ Next: Kumo cloud races, leaderboards, kingdoms, a vast open world
Plans can change, and your feedback shapes them.
💬 Tell us in our Discord. #HopToOlympus

Today on the cloud: Kumo ☁️ Hatch an egg, feed and care for your Kumo, and watch it grow into one of six adult forms.
One in a hundred hatches is ultra-rare, and the odds are public.
Which one are you hatching? 👇 #HopToOlympus #Kumo
Three armor upgrades, swipe through ➡️ 1️⃣ Turtle Armor 2️⃣ Shadow Garb 3️⃣ Erebus Armor More armor is on the way. 🧪 Alpha test: opening soon. #HopToOlympus

Build your own map. 🧱 Place the start, finish and checkpoints, publish it and earn creator stars: ⭐ +1 for a new player ⭐ +2 for every finish ⭐ +5 for a like Every map has its own leaderboard. What would you build? 👇 #HopToOlympus #mapeditor

Loading tip ☁️
Hop on the beat: every jump in a streak is faster, and the fifth one is a mega jump.
Which tip should we show next? 👇 #HopToOlympus
1.47 MB. 📦 That's the whole game: one file, zero installs. A custom voxel engine on Three.js and 140,000+ blocks, running in your browser. 🧪 Alpha test: opening soon. #HopToOlympus #buildinpublic
Play together. 🤝 Up to 32 players in one room: shared bosses, shared loot and XP, and one shared boss health bar. Pick your hero and jump in. Who is your co-op partner? 👇 #HopToOlympus
Your craft receipt 🧾 3 mole claws + 5 slime = 1 grappling hook. Mobs drop materials, recipes turn them into gear: 32 items and 8 relics. What would you craft first? 👇 #HopToOlympus
Who's that boss? 👀 He sits on a cloud and throws lightning. One of 33 bosses. A) Kronos B) Zeus C) Medusa D) Oceanus Answer in the comments 👇 #HopToOlympus
